NCGA bill page lists Iler among the co-sponsors of House Bill 589, VIVA/Election Reform (filed 4/4/2013, became S.L. 2013-381). The filed text says it would require voters to provide photo identification and set up a voter information verification effort to help registered voters without photo ID obtain one. The co-sponsor list is the bill's full list; the page does not say on which date he signed on.
subjects: free ID for voters without one

findings.note: NCGA bill page lists Iler among the co-sponsors of House Bill 351, Restore Confidence in Government (filed 3/14/2011; the page shows a Governor's veto and veto-override votes). The filed text says it would restore confidence in government by requiring that voters provide photo identification before voting, with other election and campaign-finance provisions. The page does not say on which date he signed on.
